conclusion: Repaired SR delivers full usable candidate formulas into model context. World02 demonstrates a complete actual-PySR pair fitted and submitted at 95 points; world05 reuses only the ax structure and supplies its own ay, scoring 32.18. Other sessions reject candidates or do not call SR. This one six-world batch has two >=90 and does not establish stable performance improvement or hidden-world generalization. A separate truncated draft JSON/history failure interrupted world04; original records and scores remain untouched.
